placements.role: Builds direct-to-chip liquid-cooled servers, CDUs and facility-side cooling infrastructure for AI data centers.

business_summary: Super Micro Computer, Inc. (NASDAQ: SMCI) is a server and storage systems builder that has become one of the most direct AI-server plays, with revenue growing more than four-fold between fiscal 2022 and fiscal 2025 on GPU-server demand. Its ai-infrastructure exposure on the liquid-cooling link is its own DLC-2 direct-liquid-cooling systems and rack-scale cooling infrastructure, which it both builds into its own servers and sells as facility infrastructure, making it unusual on this link for selling cooling as part of a fuller AI-server stack rather than as a standalone HVAC product.

exposure_summary.narrative: SUPERMICRO has one placement, on liquid-cooling (Thermal & liquid cooling, verdict EMERGING, money_corner False). The liquid-cooling link carries a crowdedness score of 58: the category leader is widely covered while second-tier and component suppliers remain much less followed, and multiple industrial incumbents announced competing cooling lines in 2025-26, raising commoditization risk at the component layer (data/chains/ai-infrastructure.json heat, as_of 2026-08-28).

revenue_cagr_3y.basis: Three-year compound annual revenue growth computed as (21972042000 / 5196099000) ** (1/3) - 1 from the companyfacts Revenues series, fiscal year ended 2022-06-30 to fiscal year ended 2025-06-30.

operating_margin.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/SMCI.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
operating_margin.basis: OperatingIncomeLoss 1252994000 divided by Revenues 21972042000 for the fiscal year ended 2025-06-30, both from companyfacts.

operating_cash_flow_to_net_income.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/SMCI.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
operating_cash_flow_to_net_income.basis: Net cash provided by operating activities 1659524000 divided by net income 1048854000 for the fiscal year ended 2025-06-30, both from companyfacts. Fiscal 2024 operating cash flow was sharply negative (-2485972000) in the companyfacts series; fiscal 2025 is the first positive year since fiscal 2023, so this ratio should be read as one recovery year, not a stable multi-year average.

fcf_margin.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/SMCI.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
fcf_margin.basis: Free cash flow margin: operating cash flow 1659524000 less capital expenditure 127214000 = 1532310000.0, divided by revenue 21972042000, all for the fiscal year ended 2025-06-30 from companyfacts.

net_debt_to_ebitda.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/SMCI.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
net_debt_to_ebitda.basis: Net debt -1204678000 (total debt 85646000 as of 2024-03-31, roughly two years stale in companyfacts coverage, less cash 1290324000 as of 2026-03-31) divided by an EBITDA proxy 1293994000 (operating income 1252994000 plus depreciation and amortization 41000000 for the fiscal year ended 2025-06-30). Net debt is negative (a net-cash position); debt is small enough relative to cash that even a materially higher current debt figure would likely leave the company net-cash, so the negative sign is treated as directionally reliable despite the stale debt input.

price_to_earnings.basis: Market capitalization 22030599960.0 divided by fiscal year 2025-06-30 GAAP net income 1048854000.

ev_to_sales.source_name: Upstream market store data/market/SMCI.json quality.derived over SEC companyfacts revenue
ev_to_sales.basis: Enterprise value 20825921960.0 divided by fiscal year 2025-06-30 revenue 21972042000. Enterprise value is below market capitalization because the company is in a net-cash position.

implied_fcf_cagr.basis: Free-cash-flow CAGR the current enterprise value 20825921960.0 implies over a 5-year explicit period on base FCF 1532310000.0, solved by bisection at a 0.09 discount rate and 0.025 terminal growth. The solve is slightly negative, meaning the current enterprise value is consistent with free cash flow holding roughly flat to slightly down rather than requiring further growth, the lowest implied bar in this ten-issuer batch. Assumption-dependent, not a reported figure.

horizon_spread.basis: Spread between the implied CAGR solved over the shortest and longest explicit periods in quality.reverse_dcf.implied_by_horizon ({'5': -0.0089, '7': -0.0009, '10': 0.0052}), the tightest spread in this batch. Measures how much of the reading is a horizon convention rather than a statement about price.

crowdedness_caveats: The liquid-cooling link carries a crowdedness score of 58: the category leader is widely covered while second-tier and component suppliers remain much less followed, and multiple industrial incumbents announced competing cooling lines in 2025-26, raising commoditization risk at the component layer (data/chains/ai-infrastructure.json heat, as_of 2026-08-28).

Direct competitor to CARRIER-GLOBAL, JOHNSON-CONTROLS and MODINE-MANUFACTURING on this same liquid-cooling link, all profiled in this same batch, though Supermicro's placement is really a server-and-rack business that also sells cooling, unlike the other three, which are HVAC and thermal-management incumbents entering the category.

No data-centre or AI-infrastructure revenue percentage is disclosed separately for Supermicro's cooling business; cooling is sold bundled with servers and racks rather than broken out as its own reporting line.
